# ChauffeurNYC

> Premier luxury chauffeur service and private driver in New York City.

## Overview
ChauffeurNYC provides discreet, professional private chauffeur and executive luxury car services throughout New York City (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens) and the tri-state area. Operating 24/7 for VIP clients, corporate executives, airport transfers, celebrations, and special occasions.

## Primary Services
- **Luxury Chauffeur Service NYC**: Professional personal chauffeurs delivering an uncompromising standard of service.
- **Private Driver NYC**: Discreet, punctual personal transportation tailored for executives, VIPs, and residents.
- **NYC Luxury Car Service**: Premium black car transportation across Manhattan and tri-state destinations.
- **Hourly Chauffeur Service NYC**: Flexible hourly hire for meetings, dining, shopping, and events.
- **Airport Transfers**: Punctual 24/7 transfers serving JFK, LaGuardia (LGA), and Newark Liberty (EWR).
- **Birthday Driver & Special Events**: Dedicated luxury driver for birthdays, celebrations, nightlife, and milestones.
- **Exotic Fleet for Photoshoots**: Specialized vehicle access for cinema, fashion, and commercial photography.

## Fleet Collection
- Mercedes-Benz S-Class Long Wheelbase (Executive Elite, 3 Passengers)
- Cadillac Escalade Platinum (Commanding Luxury SUV, 6 Passengers)
- Maybach Truck / SUV (Prestige Reimagined, VIP)
- Lamborghini Urus (Super SUV Performance, 4 Passengers)
- BMW 7 Series (Executive Luxury Sedan)
- McLaren 720S (Photo shoot & cinema only)
- Ferrari Roma (Photo shoot & cinema only)

## Service Areas
- New York City (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens)
- New York State & Tri-State Area
- Major Airports: JFK International, LaGuardia (LGA), Newark Liberty (EWR)
